name: pagination-34
description: Billing card listing invoices page by page with status badges.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Badge } from "@workspace/ui/components/badge" import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardFooter, CardHeader, CardTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/card" import { Pagination, PaginationContent, PaginationItem, PaginationLink, PaginationNext, PaginationPrevious, } from "@workspace/ui/components/pagination" const invoices = [ { id: "INV-2041", date: "Nov 1, 2026", amount: "$249.00", status: "Paid" }, { id: "INV-2017", date: "Oct 1, 2026", amount: "$249.00", status: "Paid" }, { id: "INV-1988", date: "Sep 1, 2026", amount: "$199.00", status: "Refunded", }, { id: "INV-1952", date: "Aug 1, 2026", amount: "$199.00", status: "Paid" }, { id: "INV-1930", date: "Jul 1, 2026", amount: "$199.00", status: "Failed" }, { id: "INV-1904", date: "Jun 1, 2026", amount: "$199.00", status: "Paid" }, ] const PAGE_SIZE = 3 export default function InvoiceListPagination() { const [page, setPage] = React.useState(1) const pageCount = Math.ceil(invoices.length / PAGE_SIZE) const rows = invoices.slice((page - 1) * PAGE_SIZE, page * PAGE_SIZE) return ( Invoices Billing history for your designali.com account {rows.map((invoice) => (
{invoice.id} {invoice.date}
{invoice.amount} {invoice.status}
))} { event.preventDefault() setPage((p) => Math.max(1, p - 1)) }} /> {Array.from({ length: pageCount }, (_, i) => i + 1).map((p) => ( { event.preventDefault() setPage(p) }} > {p} ))} { event.preventDefault() setPage((p) => Math.min(pageCount, p + 1)) }} /> ) }
